set.body:
Scope: modules/mvpa and modules/pipeline integration.

Deliverable: Keep reusable measurement/execution contracts in the candidate MVPA core; move ScalaFIM pipeline interpretation to its optional integration.

Acceptance:
- Core sources and public API require no pipeline runtime or ScalaFIM dependency.
- Existing pipeline workflows still execute the same measurement plan and preserve cancellation/resource ownership behavior where supported.
- No new universal workflow abstraction is introduced; migrated interpreter has focused JVM/JS regression evidence.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U1: Separate MVPA plans from the pipeline interpreter
